basic_info.description: Classic architecture meets modern luxury in this exceptional Pacific Heights home. Stepping inside, you're welcomed by a grand formal foyer and sweeping staircase. The expansive living room is framed by a picture-perfect view of the San Francisco Bay and enjoys a wrap-around step out deck. The main level also features a gourmet kitchen and eat-in family room + butler's pantry. Upstairs, the gracious primary suite boasts showstopping views of the Golden Gate Bridge and Marin Headlands. There are two additional bedrooms and a laundry room on this level. Up just one flight of stairs is a spectacular pent room with a wet-bar and a walk out deck with a hot tub and firepit. There is an additional bedroom and full bathroom on this level. There are two more lower levels which include an additional family room space, 2 more bedrooms, interior access from the 2-car garage and a large recreation room opening to the flat garden with a built-in trampoline. Additional highlights include a temperature-controlled wine room, air filtration system, top-level air conditioning, and 3 gas fireplaces. Extensively remodeled by Thompson Suskind in 2016 this home sits on a premier Pacific Heights block with unbeatable access to the Presidio, Fillmore and Union Street shopping.
